run_training_benchmark: run a training benchmark comparing fp32 baseline against bf16 candidate settings and return fidelity metrics
run_training_benchmark_runner: run the TrainingBenchmarkRunner to benchmark training throughput and save a JSON report to results directory
create_benchmark_train_callback: create a BenchmarkTrainCallback that captures per-step losses, grad norms, and step times during training
run_single_training_session: run a single training session with _run_single using a config path and Hydra overrides
review_training_benchmark_result: review the TrainingBenchmarkResult dataclass fields for loss error, grad norm error, steps per second, and peak memory
